description: The dated record of what changed, newest first. Every entry states its KIND, and most of this tape is FirmFax correcting its own data rather than a firm changing its rules. Read counts before describing industry activity: a total taken across kinds overstates it.

kind.description: firm = the firm changed a rule. record = FirmFax corrected its own data. withdrawn = we published an entry and then retracted it.

limit.description: How many entries to return, newest first. Default 50.

since.description: ISO date, e.g. "2026-08-01". Entries dated on or after it.

slug.description: Limit to one firm. Omit for every firm.

name: get_rule_changes
